# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in Mini-Segmentor, please open a private GitHub advisory or contact the maintainers directly. Please do not disclose vulnerabilities through public issues or forum posts until a patch has been published.
